content.description: Exploded view of oil pump assembly showing driven gear, drive gear, and pump body positioned on torque converter

items.heading: INSTALL DRIVEN GEAR AND DRIVE GEAR AND SET PUMP BODY ON TORQUE CONVERTER
items.text: Make sure the top of the gears is facing upward.

content.description: Installation of pump cover with SST tool alignment, showing bolt holes and wave washers

items.heading: LOOSELY INSTALL PUMP COVER
items.text: Align the bolt holes and drop the pump cover into place. Install the six bolts with wave washers finger tight.

items.heading: ALIGN PUMP AND PUMP COVER
items.text: Install the SST around the pump and cover. Tighten SST to align the pump and cover.

content.description: Installation of two oil seal rings on pump cover, showing rings being spread apart and slid into groove

items.heading: INSTALL TWO OIL SEAL RINGS ON PUMP COVER
items.text: Spread the rings apart and slide them into the groove. Hook both ends by hand. Wipe off excess petroleum jelly.

items.heading: INSTALL NEW O-RING ON PUMP COVER
items.text: Make sure a new O-ring is not twisted and is fully seated in the groove.

content.description: Checking pump drive gear rotation with SST tool to ensure smooth rotation

items.heading: CHECK PUMP DRIVE GEAR ROTATION
items.text: Turn the drive gear with SST and make sure that it rotates smoothly.
